[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Karr''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] stationed in the [[Monor system/Legends|Monor system]]. He led the boarding party that captured [[Daye Azur-Jamin]], [[Woyiq]], and [[Toalar Yalom Yalom]].
